description: This file contains test cases for two configuration resolution functions related to filesystem policies within the OpenClaw project. It tests how the functions determine effective settings based on global and agent-specific configurations, particularly for workspace restrictions and root expansion permissions.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsWorkspaceOnly
methods.description: Determines if the workspace-only setting is effective for a given agent based on global and agent-specific configurations.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Determines if root expansion is allowed based on global and agent-specific configuration profiles.
